d: Enjoy all goals and match highlights from Senegal vs Cuba in Group F of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026. Senegal earned a 9-0 group stage win at Aspire Zone in Doha behind braces from Ibrahima Dione and Sega Mbodji alongside goals from Mouhamed Faye, Sidy Ndiaye, Ibrahima Konte, El Hadji Ibrahima Sow, and Maurice Biaye.
